title: add-default-source-to-telemetry-properties
request: Can we make telemetry events always include a `source` property set to "browser_use" unless the event already defines it? Update the capture logic in ProductTelemetry._direct_capture.
reference_diff:
--- a/browser_use/telemetry/service.py
+++ b/browser_use/telemetry/service.py
@@ -117,7 +117,7 @@
 			self._posthog_client.capture(
 				distinct_id=self.user_id,
 				event=event.name,
-				properties={**event.properties, **POSTHOG_EVENT_SETTINGS},
+				properties={**{'source': 'browser_use'}, **event.properties, **POSTHOG_EVENT_SETTINGS},
 			)
 		except Exception as e:
 			logger.error(f'Failed to send telemetry event {event.name}: {e}')
test_diff:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/ci/test_telemetry_source_property.py
@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+import builtins
+import types
+
+import pytest
+
+from browser_use.telemetry.service import ProductTelemetry, BaseTelemetryEvent
+
+class DummyClient:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.captured = []
+
+    def capture(self, distinct_id, event, properties):
+        self.captured.append({
+            "distinct_id": distinct_id,
+            "event": event,
+            "properties": properties,
+        })
+
+class SimpleEvent:
+    def __init__(self, name, properties=None):
+        self.name = name
+        self.properties = properties or {}
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def reset_singleton(monkeypatch):
+    # Ensure a fresh singleton for each test
+    # The singleton decorator caches the instance in the class; clear it
+    if hasattr(ProductTelemetry, "_instance"):
+        delattr(ProductTelemetry, "_instance")
+    yield
+
+def test_default_source_added(monkeypatch):
+    telemetry = ProductTelemetry()
+    dummy = DummyClient()
+    # Force a known user id to avoid filesystem reads
+    telemetry._curr_user_id = "test-user"
+    telemetry._posthog_client = dummy
+
+    event = SimpleEvent(name="test_event", properties={"foo": "bar"})
+    telemetry.capture(event)
+
+    assert len(dummy.captured) == 1
+    captured = dummy.captured[0]
+    assert captured["event"] == "test_event"
+    # default source should be present
+    assert captured["properties"]["source"] == "browser_use"
+    assert captured["properties"]["foo"] == "bar"
+
+def test_source_override(monkeypatch):
+    telemetry = ProductTelemetry()
+    dummy = DummyClient()
+    telemetry._curr_user_id = "test-user"
+    telemetry._posthog_client = dummy
+
+    event = SimpleEvent(name="override_event", properties={"source": "custom_source", "x": 1})
+    telemetry.capture(event)
+
+    assert len(dummy.captured) == 1
+    captured = dummy.captured[0]
+    # The provided source should win over the default
+    assert captured["properties"]["source"] == "custom_source"
+    assert captured["properties"]["x"] == 1
